title: 稀疏交换 Warm 预算 MB（sparse_swap_budget_mb）
title_en: Sparse swap warm budget in MB

standard.summary: 限制 warm prefetch 的 FP16 等效预算。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Caps the FP16-equivalent budget for warm prefetch.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 限制 warm prefetch 的 FP16 等效预算。0 表示不额外限制，只按 Warm 比例。

advanced_en.principle: Caps the FP16-equivalent budget for warm prefetch. 0 = no extra limit, governed by the warm ratio alone.
